games.label: Games
games.help: Which games are included in this slot.

combo_goal.label: Combo Goal
combo_goal.help: How completion is determined when both games are enabled.

death_link.label: Death Link
death_link.help: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.help:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

progression_balancing.label: Progression Balancing
progression_balancing.help:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

Goal.label: Goal
Goal.help: The goal required of you in order to complete your run in Archipelago.

GrubHuntGoal.label: Grub Hunt Goal
GrubHuntGoal.help:
The amount of grubs required to finish Grub Hunt.
On 'All' any grubs from item links replacements etc. will be counted

WhitePalace.label: White Palace
WhitePalace.help:
Whether or not to include White Palace or not. Note: Even if excluded, the King Fragment check may still be
required if charms are vanilla.

StartLocation.label: Start Location
StartLocation.help: Choose your start location. This is currently only locked to King's Pass.

StartingGeo.label: Starting Geo
StartingGeo.help: The amount of starting geo you have.

PreciseMovement.label: Precise Movement
PreciseMovement.help:
Places skips into logic which require extremely precise player movement, possibly without movement skills such as
dash or claw.

ProficientCombat.label: Proficient Combat
ProficientCombat.help: Places skips into logic which require proficient combat, possibly with limited items.

BackgroundObjectPogos.label: Background Object Pogos
BackgroundObjectPogos.help: Places skips into logic for locations which are reachable via pogoing off of background objects.

EnemyPogos.label: Enemy Pogos
EnemyPogos.help: Places skips into logic for locations which are reachable via pogos off of enemies.

ObscureSkips.label: Obscure Skips
ObscureSkips.help: Places skips into logic which are considered obscure enough that a beginner is not expected to know them.

ShadeSkips.label: Shade Skips
ShadeSkips.help: Places shade skips into logic which utilize the player's shade for pogoing or damage boosting.

InfectionSkips.label: Infection Skips
InfectionSkips.help: Places skips into logic which are only possible after the crossroads become infected.

FireballSkips.label: Fireball Skips
FireballSkips.help: Places skips into logic which require the use of spells to reset fall speed while in mid-air.

SpikeTunnels.label: Spike Tunnels
SpikeTunnels.help: Places skips into logic which require the navigation of narrow tunnels filled with spikes.

AcidSkips.label: Acid Skips
AcidSkips.help: Places skips into logic which require crossing a pool of acid without Isma's Tear, or water if swim is disabled.

DamageBoosts.label: Damage Boosts
DamageBoosts.help: Places skips into logic which require you to take damage from an enemy or hazard to progress.

DangerousSkips.label: Dangerous Skips
DangerousSkips.help: Places skips into logic which contain a high risk of taking damage.

DarkRooms.label: Dark Rooms
DarkRooms.help: Places skips into logic which require navigating dark rooms without the use of the Lumafly Lantern.

ComplexSkips.label: Complex Skips
ComplexSkips.help: Places skips into logic which require intense setup or are obscure even beyond advanced skip standards.

DifficultSkips.label: Difficult Skips
DifficultSkips.help: Places skips into logic which are considered more difficult than typical.

ExtraPlatforms.label: Extra Platforms
ExtraPlatforms.help: Places additional platforms to make traveling throughout Hallownest more convenient.

RandomizeDreamers.label: Randomize Dreamers
RandomizeDreamers.help:
Allow for Dreamers to be randomized into the item pool and opens their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 4 locations.

RandomizeSkills.label: Randomize Skills
RandomizeSkills.help:
Allow for Skills, such as Mantis Claw or Shade Soul, to be randomized into the item pool. Also opens their locations
for receiving randomized items.
This option adds approximately 18 locations.

RandomizeFocus.label: Randomize Focus
RandomizeFocus.help:
Removes the ability to focus and randomizes it into the item pool.
This option adds approximately 1 location.

RandomizeCharms.label: Randomize Charms
RandomizeCharms.help:
Allow for Charms to be randomized into the item pool and open their locations for randomization. Includes Charms
sold in shops.
This option adds approximately 45 locations.

RandomizeKeys.label: Randomize Keys
RandomizeKeys.help:
Allow for Keys to be randomized into the item pool. Includes those sold in shops.
This option adds approximately 13 locations.

RandomizeMaskShards.label: Randomize Mask Shards
RandomizeMaskShards.help:
Allow for Mask Shard to be randomized into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 16 locations.

RandomizeVesselFragments.label: Randomize Vessel Fragments
RandomizeVesselFragments.help:
Allow for Vessel Fragments to be randomized into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 9 locations.

RandomizeCharmNotches.label: Randomize Charm Notches
RandomizeCharmNotches.help:
Allow for Charm Notches to be randomized into the item pool. Includes those sold by Salubra.
This option adds approximately 9 locations.

RandomizePaleOre.label: Randomize Pale Ore
RandomizePaleOre.help:
Randomize Pale Ores into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 6 locations.

RandomizeGeoChests.label: Randomize Geo Chests
RandomizeGeoChests.help:
Allow for Geo Chests to contain randomized items, as well as their Geo reward being randomized into the item pool.
This option adds approximately 8 locations.

RandomizeJunkPitChests.label: Randomize Junk Pit Chests
RandomizeJunkPitChests.help:
Randomize the contents of junk pit chests into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 5 locations.

RandomizeRancidEggs.label: Randomize Rancid Eggs
RandomizeRancidEggs.help:
Randomize Rancid Eggs into the item pool and open their locations for randomization
This option adds approximately 20 locations.

RandomizeRelics.label: Randomize Relics
RandomizeRelics.help:
Randomize Relics (King's Idol, et al.) into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 43 locations.

RandomizeWhisperingRoots.label: Randomize Whispering Roots
RandomizeWhisperingRoots.help:
Randomize the essence rewards from Whispering Roots into the item pool. Whispering Roots will now grant a randomized
item when completed. This can be previewed by standing on the root.
This option adds approximately 15 locations.

RandomizeBossEssence.label: Randomize Boss Essence
RandomizeBossEssence.help:
Randomize boss essence drops, such as those for defeating Warrior Dreams, into the item pool and open their locations
for randomization.
This option adds approximately 12 locations.

RandomizeGrubs.label: Randomize Grubs
RandomizeGrubs.help:
Randomize Grubs into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 46 locations.

RandomizeMimics.label: Randomize Mimics
RandomizeMimics.help:
Randomize Mimic Grubs into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 4 locations.

RandomizeMaps.label: Randomize Maps
RandomizeMaps.help:
Randomize Maps into the item pool. This causes Cornifer to give you a message allowing you to see and buy an item
that is randomized into that location as well.
This option adds approximately 15 locations.

RandomizeStags.label: Randomize Stags
RandomizeStags.help:
Randomize Stag Stations unlocks into the item pool as well as placing randomized items on the stag station bell/toll.
This option adds approximately 11 locations.

RandomizeLifebloodCocoons.label: Randomize Lifeblood Cocoons
RandomizeLifebloodCocoons.help:
Randomize Lifeblood Cocoon grants into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 8 locations.

RandomizeGrimmkinFlames.label: Randomize Grimmkin Flames
RandomizeGrimmkinFlames.help:
Randomize Grimmkin Flames into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 10 locations.

RandomizeJournalEntries.label: Randomize Journal Entries
RandomizeJournalEntries.help:
Randomize the Hunter's Journal as well as the findable journal entries into the item pool, and open their locations
for randomization. Does not include journal entries gained by killing enemies.
This option adds approximately 6 locations.

RandomizeNail.label: Randomize Nail
RandomizeNail.help:
Removes the ability to swing the nail left, right and up, and shuffles these into the item pool.
This option adds approximately 0 locations.

RandomizeGeoRocks.label: Randomize Geo Rocks
RandomizeGeoRocks.help:
Randomize Geo Rock rewards into the item pool and open their locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 207 locations.

RandomizeBossGeo.label: Randomize Boss Geo
RandomizeBossGeo.help:
Randomize boss Geo drops into the item pool and open those locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 8 locations.

RandomizeSoulTotems.label: Randomize Soul Totems
RandomizeSoulTotems.help:
Randomize Soul Refill items into the item pool and open the Soul Totem locations for randomization.
This option adds approximately 59 locations.

RandomizeLoreTablets.label: Randomize Lore Tablets
RandomizeLoreTablets.help:
Randomize Lore items into the itempool, one per Lore Tablet, and place randomized item grants on the tablets themselves.
You must still read the tablet to get the item.
This option adds approximately 33 locations.

RandomizeElevatorPass.label: Randomize Elevator Pass
RandomizeElevatorPass.help:
Adds an Elevator Pass item to the item pool, which is then required to use the large elevators connecting
City of Tears to the Forgotten Crossroads and Resting Grounds.

RandomizeSwim.label: Randomize Swim
RandomizeSwim.help:
Removes the ability to swim in water and randomizes it into the item pool.
This option adds approximately 0 locations.

SplitCrystalHeart.label: Split Crystal Heart
SplitCrystalHeart.help: Splits the Crystal Heart into left- and right-only versions of the item.

SplitMothwingCloak.label: Split Mothwing Cloak
SplitMothwingCloak.help:
Splits the Mothwing Cloak into left- and right-only versions of the item. Randomly adds a second left or
right Mothwing cloak item which functions as the upgrade to Shade Cloak.

SplitMantisClaw.label: Split Mantis Claw
SplitMantisClaw.help: Splits the Mantis Claw into left- and right-only versions of the item.

MinimumGeoPrice.label: Minimum Geo Price
MinimumGeoPrice.help: The minimum geo price for items in geo shops.

MaximumGeoPrice.label: Maximum Geo Price
MaximumGeoPrice.help: The maximum geo price for items in geo shops.

MinimumGrubPrice.label: Minimum Grub Price
MinimumGrubPrice.help: The minimum grub price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Grubfather.

MaximumGrubPrice.label: Maximum Grub Price
MaximumGrubPrice.help: The maximum grub price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Grubfather.

MinimumEssencePrice.label: Minimum Essence Price
MinimumEssencePrice.help: The minimum essence price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Seer.

MaximumEssencePrice.label: Maximum Essence Price
MaximumEssencePrice.help: The maximum essence price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Seer.

MinimumCharmPrice.label: Minimum Charm Requirement
MinimumCharmPrice.help:
The minimum charm price in the range of prices that an item should cost for Salubra's shop item which also
carry a charm cost.

MaximumCharmPrice.label: Maximum Charm Requirement
MaximumCharmPrice.help:
The maximum charm price in the range of prices that an item should cost for Salubra's shop item which also
carry a charm cost.

RandomCharmCosts.label: Randomize Charm Notch Costs
RandomCharmCosts.help:
Total Notch Cost of all Charms together. Vanilla sums to 90.
This value is distributed among all charms in a random fashion.
Special Cases:
Set to -1 or vanilla for vanilla costs.
Set to -2 or shuffle to shuffle around the vanilla costs to different charms.

PlandoCharmCosts.label: Charm Notch Cost Plando
PlandoCharmCosts.help:
Allows setting a Charm's Notch costs directly, mapping {name: cost}.
This is set after any random Charm Notch costs, if applicable.

MinimumEggPrice.label: Minimum Egg Price
MinimumEggPrice.help:
The minimum rancid egg price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Jiji.
Only takes effect if the EggSlotShops option is greater than 0.

MaximumEggPrice.label: Maximum Egg Price
MaximumEggPrice.help:
The maximum rancid egg price in the range of prices that an item should cost from Jiji.
Only takes effect if the EggSlotShops option is greater than 0.

EggShopSlots.label: Egg Shop Item Slots
EggShopSlots.help: For each slot, add a location to the Egg Shop and a filler item to the item pool.

SlyShopSlots.label: Sly Shop Slots
SlyShopSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Sly Shop and a filler item to the item pool.

SlyKeyShopSlots.label: Sly Key Shop Slots
SlyKeyShopSlots.help:
For each extra slot, add a location to the Sly Shop (requiring Shopkeeper's Key) and a filler item to the item
pool.

IseldaShopSlots.label: Iselda Shop Slots
IseldaShopSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Iselda Shop and a filler item to the item pool.

SalubraShopSlots.label: Salubra Shop Slots
SalubraShopSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Salubra Shop, and a filler item to the item pool.

SalubraCharmShopSlots.label: Salubra Charm Shop Slots
SalubraCharmShopSlots.help:
For each extra slot, add a location to the Salubra Shop (requiring Charms), and a filler item to the item
pool.

LegEaterShopSlots.label: Leg Eater Shop Slots
LegEaterShopSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Leg Eater Shop and a filler item to the item pool.

GrubfatherRewardSlots.label: Grubfather Reward Slots
GrubfatherRewardSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Grubfather and a filler item to the item pool.

SeerRewardSlots.label: Seer Reward Reward Slots
SeerRewardSlots.help: For each extra slot, add a location to the Seer and a filler item to the item pool.

ExtraShopSlots.label: Additional Shop Slots
ExtraShopSlots.help:
For each extra slot, add a location to a randomly chosen shop a filler item to the item pool.

The Egg Shop will be excluded from this list unless it has at least one item.

Shops are capped at 16 items each.

CostSanity.label: Costsanity
CostSanity.help:
If enabled, most locations with costs (like stag stations) will have randomly determined costs.
If set to shopsonly, CostSanity will only apply to shops (including Grubfather, Seer and Egg Shop).
If set to notshops, CostSanity will only apply to non-shops (e.g. Stag stations and Cornifer locations)

These costs can be in Geo (except Grubfather, Seer and Eggshop), Grubs, Charms, Essence and/or Rancid Eggs

CostSanityHybridChance.label: Costsanity Hybrid Chance
CostSanityHybridChance.help: The chance that a CostSanity cost will include two components instead of one, e.g. Grubs + Essence

CostSanityEggWeight.label: Costsanity Egg Weight
CostSanityEggWeight.help: The likelihood of Costsanity choosing a Egg cost. Chosen as a sum of all weights from other types.

CostSanityGrubWeight.label: Costsanity Grub Weight
CostSanityGrubWeight.help: The likelihood of Costsanity choosing a Grub cost. Chosen as a sum of all weights from other types.

CostSanityEssenceWeight.label: Costsanity Essence Weight
CostSanityEssenceWeight.help: The likelihood of Costsanity choosing a Essence cost. Chosen as a sum of all weights from other types.

CostSanityCharmWeight.label: Costsanity Charm Weight
CostSanityCharmWeight.help: The likelihood of Costsanity choosing a Charm cost. Chosen as a sum of all weights from other types.

CostSanityGeoWeight.label: Costsanity Geo Weight
CostSanityGeoWeight.help: The likelihood of Costsanity choosing a Geo cost. Chosen as a sum of all weights from other types. Geo costs will never be chosen for Grubfather, Seer, or Egg Shop.

DeathLinkShade.label: Deathlink Shade Handling
DeathLinkShade.help:
Sets whether to create a shade when you are killed by a DeathLink and how to handle your existing shade, if any.

vanilla: DeathLink deaths function like any other death and overrides your existing shade (including geo), if any.
shadeless: DeathLink deaths do not spawn shades. Your existing shade (including geo), if any, is untouched.
shade: DeathLink deaths spawn a shade if you do not have an existing shade. Otherwise, it acts like shadeless.

* This option has no effect if DeathLink is disabled.
** Self-death shade behavior is not changed; if a self-death normally creates a shade in vanilla, it will override
    your existing shade, if any.

DeathLinkBreaksFragileCharms.label: Deathlink Breaks Fragile Charms
DeathLinkBreaksFragileCharms.help:
Sets if fragile charms break when you are killed by a DeathLink.

* This option has no effect if DeathLink is disabled.
** Self-death fragile charm behavior is not changed; if a self-death normally breaks fragile charms in vanilla, it
    will continue to do so.

RemoveSpellUpgrades.label: Remove Spell Upgrades
RemoveSpellUpgrades.help: Removes the second level of all spells from the item pool.

AddUnshuffledLocations.label: Add Unshuffled Locations
AddUnshuffledLocations.help:
Adds non-randomized locations to the location pool, which allows syncing
of location state with co-op or automatic collection via collect.

Note: This will increase the number of location checks required to purchase
hints to the total maximum.

game_mode.label: Game Mode
game_mode.help: Choose Classic or Steel Soul. Steel Soul changes some checks and ends the save on death.

goal.label: Goal
goal.help:
Act 1-3 require beating the chosen act, Cursed Ending is self
explanatory, Flea Hunt is getting the set amount of fleas and Spelling Bee
is getting every unique letter in the chosen phrase with Alphabet Rando on.

spelling_bee_phrase.label: Spelling Bee Phrase
spelling_bee_phrase.help:
The word or phrase used by the Spelling Bee goal.

A-Z letters, spaces, commas, periods, question marks and exclamation marks
are supported. At least one letter is required. Other characters change the goal to
Act 2 and do not automatically enable Alphabet Mode.

bellway_access.label: Bellway Access
bellway_access.help: Choose whether Bell Beast must be defeated before using Bellways.

flea_hunt_count.label: Flea Hunt Count
flea_hunt_count.help: Number of distinct AP Fleas received for Flea Hunt victory.

silk_and_soul_points.label: Silk and Soul Points
silk_and_soul_points.help:
Wish points required for Silk and Soul for the Act 3 goal. Other goals
keep the vanilla 17-point requirement. Mandatory wishes and story
requirements remain unchanged. Nuu's wish does not count in logic.
Values above 23 are treated as 23, or 22 in Steel Soul.

trails_end_requirement.label: Trail's End Requirement
trails_end_requirement.help: Choose whether Trail's End uses 14 Shakra map-stock purchases or received maps.

starting_location.label: Starting Location
starting_location.help:
Choose your starting location and F4 destination. Alternate starts have a checkpoint immediately.
Bone Bottom's F4 warp unlocks after visiting.

Songclave requires an Act 2 or later goal.
Randomized Ledge Grab replaces Vanilla with Bone Bottom.

starting_crest.label: Starting Crest
starting_crest.help:
Choose Hornet's starting Crest when Crests are randomized.

random selects one of the seven Crests.

start_fully_mapped.label: Start Fully Mapped
start_fully_mapped.help:
Start with the full world map drawn, regardless of map ownership.
This does not grant map items. Use Start With Maps to receive them.

automatic_compass.label: Automatic Compass
automatic_compass.help: Always show Hornet on maps without granting or equipping Compass.

platforming_capability.label: Platforming Capability
platforming_capability.help:
Normal uses ordinary platforming routes. Proficient Movement allows
precise inputs and advanced uses of movement abilities.
Elite Ball Knowledge also includes routes marked for that setting.

proficient_combat.label: Proficient Combat
proficient_combat.help:
Choose the preferred combat requirements settings.

Off: use the normal combat requirements.
Goated: lower Needle, DPS and Crafting Kit requirements by one tier and Mask Shard requirements by four fragments.
Hell: bypass combat requirements including combat movement.

damage_boost_logic.label: Damage Boost Logic
damage_boost_logic.help:
Take a hit to cross an obstacle using knockback or invulnerability.
None disables these routes. Higher settings also allow easier boosts.

flea_brew_jump_logic.label: Flea Brew Jump Logic
flea_brew_jump_logic.help:
Use Flea Brew's movement speed boost to make longer jumps.

Its speed boost for the Weavenest Cindril secret room remains in logic
with this option disabled.

Requires Flea Brew and a crest with a usable red tool slot.

red_tool_stall_logic.label: Red Tool Stall Logic
red_tool_stall_logic.help:
Use Flea Brew, Flintslate, Plasmium Phial or Voltvessels in midair
to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

drill_crystal_pogo_logic.label: Drill Crystal Pogo Logic
drill_crystal_pogo_logic.help:
Take damage to create a Memory Crystal, then use Delver's Drill
to gain height from it. Both tools must fit on the same owned crest.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

enemy_pogo_logic.label: Enemy Pogo Skip Logic
enemy_pogo_logic.help:
Use enemy pogo tricks to gain height or cross gaps beyond ordinary traversal.

Normal enemy pogos remain available with this option set to None.

Higher settings also allow easier tricks.

crest_pogo_logic.label: Crest Pogo Skip Logic
crest_pogo_logic.help:
Use crest-specific pogo techniques to gain height or extend jumps.
Covers pogo skips for every crest.

None disables these techniques. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

needle_strike_logic.label: Needle Strike Logic
needle_strike_logic.help:
Use Needle Strike stalls and crest-specific charged attacks
to delay your fall, extend jumps or gain height.

None disables these techniques. 

Higher settings also allow easier uses.

sharpdart_logic.label: Sharpdart Logic
sharpdart_logic.help:
Use Sharpdart to cross gaps and extend jumps.

When disabled, traversal never requires Sharpdart.

scuttlebrace_logic.label: Scuttlebrace Logic
scuttlebrace_logic.help:
Use Scuttlebrace dodges to extend jumps and reach ledges.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

heal_stall_logic.label: Heal Stall Logic
heal_stall_logic.help:
Start binding in midair to briefly delay your fall and extend a jump.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

hazard_respawn_logic.label: Hazard Respawn Logic
hazard_respawn_logic.help:
Deliberately touch a hazard to return to a useful respawn point,
allowing shortcuts across gaps or obstacles.

None disables this technique. Higher settings also allow easier uses.

randomized_bell_markers.label: Randomized Bell Markers
randomized_bell_markers.help: Show map markers for your Grand Gate Bells where the randomizer placed them in your world.

randomized_melody_markers.label: Randomized Melody Markers
randomized_melody_markers.help: Show map markers for your Threefold Melody pieces where the randomizer placed them in your world.

quill_randomization.label: Quill Randomization
quill_randomization.help:
Keep Quill at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Skill Randomization. Start Fully Mapped removes the need for Quill.

compass_randomization.label: Compass Randomization
compass_randomization.help:
Keep Compass at Shakra's shop or mix it into the global item pool.

Independent of Tool Randomization. Automatic Compass supplies the position marker without the tool.

skill_randomization.label: Skill Randomization
skill_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 8 traversal skills in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

tool_randomization.label: Tool Randomization
tool_randomization.help:
Randomizes tools other than Compass in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

silk_skill_randomization.label: Silk Skill Randomization
silk_skill_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 6 Silk Skills in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

silk_soar_begone.label: Silk Soar Begone
silk_soar_begone.help:
Removes Silk Soar from runs without Act 3 areas. When Act 3 areas are included,
Silk Soar stays at its vanilla shrine, even with skill randomization enabled.

crest_randomization.label: Crest Randomization
crest_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 7 Crests in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

eva_randomization.label: Eva Reward Randomization
eva_randomization.help:
Randomizes Eva's two Hunter evolutions, two Vesticrests and Sylphsong.

false: Eva gives her normal rewards
true: mixes her rewards into the global item pool

soul_randomization.label: Act 2 Soul Randomization
soul_randomization.help: Randomizes Maiden Soul, Hermit Soul and Seeker Soul for Act 2, Cursed and Act 3 goals.

old_heart_randomization.label: Old Heart Randomization
old_heart_randomization.help: Randomizes Pollen Heart, Hunter's Heart, Encrusted Heart and Conjoined Heart for the Act 3 goal.

everbloom_randomization.label: Everbloom Randomization
everbloom_randomization.help:
Randomizes Everbloom for Act 3 goals. 
The final Abyss route still requires the three-heart ritual and Red Memory to be completed.

memento_randomization.label: Memento Randomization
memento_randomization.help:
Randomizes Mementos available for your goal. 
Hunter's Memento stays vanilla. Hearts follow Old Heart Randomization.

materium_randomization.label: Materium Randomization
materium_randomization.help: Randomizes Materium, Flintstone, Magnetite and Voltridian.

bellhome_randomization.label: Bellhome Item Randomization
bellhome_randomization.help: Randomizes Desk, Gleamlights, Bell Lacquer, Personal Spa, Gramophone and Crawbell. Crawbell is only included for Act 3 goals.

cogheart_piece_randomization.label: Cogheart Pieces Randomization
cogheart_piece_randomization.help: Randomizes the three Cogheart Pieces needed to activate Second Sentinel.

quest_collectible_randomization.label: Quest Collectible Randomization
quest_collectible_randomization.help: Randomizes Grass Doll, Horn Fragment, Crown Fragment and Broodmother's Eye.

flea_randomization.label: Flea Randomization
flea_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 30 Fleas in the game, including Kratt, Vog and the Huge Flea.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

crest_slot_randomization.label: Crest Slot Randomization
crest_slot_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 20 Crest Slots in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

If needed, filler rewards become extra Memory Lockets so every randomized
slot has enough Lockets available. Native pickups stay unchanged.

mask_shard_randomization.label: Mask Shard Randomization
mask_shard_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 20 Mask Shards in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

spool_fragment_randomization.label: Spool Fragment Randomization
spool_fragment_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 18 Spool Fragments in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

silk_heart_randomization.label: Silk Heart Randomization
silk_heart_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 3 Silk Hearts in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

silk_heart_logic.label: Silk Heart Logic
silk_heart_logic.help:
Places logical routes for abilities that require silk behind the
acquisition of at least one Silk Heart. These include Needolin,
Clawline and Silk Soar.

Turning this option off may cause more frequent soft locks as you
may get stuck in a location where you can't get more silk.

bellway_randomization.label: Bellway Randomization
bellway_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 10 Bellways in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

ventrica_randomization.label: Ventrica Randomization
ventrica_randomization.help:
Randomizes the 6 Ventricas in the game.

false: leaves them where they normally are
true: mixes them into the global item pool

map_randomization.label: Map Randomization
map_randomization.help:

diving_bell_key_randomization.help:

this key as well as accepting the shaman's The Dark Below quest.

journal_randomization.label: Journal Randomization
journal_randomization.help:
Randomizes the Hunter's Journal and boss journal entries.
Entries that need multiple kills have separate completion checks and items.

false: keeps the usual journal
true: mixes journal items into the multiworld

boss_sanity.label: Boss Credit Randomization
boss_sanity.help:
Adds boss checks and replaces their filler with boss credit items.
Receiving a credit grants that boss's story unlocks.
Items dropped by bosses follow their own randomization settings.

Fight difficulty and arena exits stay with the boss you face.
Act transitions still require their original fights.

false: keeps the usual boss progression without extra checks
true: boss credits can appear anywhere in the multiworld

wish_sanity.label: Wish Completion Checks
wish_sanity.help:
Adds completion checks for wishes without a separately randomized item reward.
Items earned from bosses and wishes follow their own randomization settings.

false: no additional wish completion checks
true: fills wish completion checks from the global item pool

shuffle_wish_offers.label: Shuffle Wish Offers
shuffle_wish_offers.help:
EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE, should be fine but please don't bring to syncs

Shuffles supported wishes between boards and NPCs independently of Wish Completion Checks.
Each wish keeps its tasks and story effects. Linked NPC follow-ups stay with
their original NPCs.

individual_relic_turn_ins.label: Individual Relic Turn-ins
individual_relic_turn_ins.help:
Make Scrounge's 15 relic and Cardinius's 6 cylinder deposits 
individual AP checks instead of paying Rosaries.

alphabet_mode.label: Alphabet Mode
alphabet_mode.help:
Add Letter A through Letter Z to the item pool and hide unowned letters in game text.

Text filtering only runs while the game language is English.
This needs at least 26 randomized filler rewards.

ledgegrab_ability_rando.label: Ledge Grab Rando
ledgegrab_ability_rando.help: Randomizes Hornet's ability to grab ledges.

directional_ledge_grab.label: Directional Ledge Grab Rando
directional_ledge_grab.help: Split Ledge Grab into Left and Right items. Automatically enables Ledge Grab Rando.

bind_randomization.label: Bind Randomization
bind_randomization.help:
Randomizes Bind for healing, heal stalls and interactions that require it.
Shared adds one Bind item for every crest. Per Crest adds a Bind item for each crest.

directional_cling_grip.label: Directional Cling Grip
directional_cling_grip.help: Split Cling Grip into Left and Right wall-clinging items with Skills set to anywhere.

directional_swift_step.label: Directional Swift Step
directional_swift_step.help:
Split Swift Step into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere.
Each item grants dash and sprint only in its direction. With Split Dash And Sprint enabled,
three Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint in both directions first,
then one dash direction chosen by the seed, then the other direction.

directional_clawline.label: Directional Clawline
directional_clawline.help: Split Clawline into Left and Right items with Skills set to anywhere.

split_dash_and_sprint.label: Split Dash And Sprint
split_dash_and_sprint.help:
With Skills set to anywhere, the first Progressive Swift Step grants sprint
and the second grants dash. With Directional Swift Step enabled, three
Progressive Swift Steps grant sprint, one dash direction chosen by the seed
then the other dash direction.

normal_shop_prices.label: Normal Shop Prices
normal_shop_prices.help: Randomize prices for ShopItem purchases other than maps and pins.

bellway_prices.label: Bellway Prices
bellway_prices.help: Randomize prices charged by Bellway toll machines.

ventrica_prices.label: Ventrica Prices
ventrica_prices.help: Randomize prices charged by Ventrica toll machines.

bench_prices.label: Bench Prices
bench_prices.help: Randomize bench unlock tolls and Underworks bench fees.

miscellaneous_prices.label: Miscellaneous Prices
miscellaneous_prices.help: Randomize Pilgrim's Rest admission and pin gallery entry fees.

map_prices.label: Map Prices
map_prices.help: Randomize prices for Shakra's area maps and Citadel map machines.

pin_prices.label: Pin Prices
pin_prices.help: Randomize prices for Shakra's permanent map pins.

upgrade_prices.label: Upgrade Prices
upgrade_prices.help: Randomize the two paid Needle-upgrade service prices.

donation_prices.label: Donation Prices
donation_prices.help: Randomize Rosary and Shell Shard Wish donation requirements.

vog_hint_prices.label: Vog Hint Prices
vog_hint_prices.help: Randomize the price of Vog's area reports.

silk_link.label: Silk Link
silk_link.help: Share only the base Spool's current Silk with other enabled Silksong players.

rosary_link.label: Rosary Link
rosary_link.help: Share loose Rosary gains and costs with other enabled Silksong players.

shell_shard_link.label: Shell Shard Link
shell_shard_link.help: Share base-pouch Shell Shard gains and costs with enabled Silksong players.

knockback_link.label: Knockback Link
knockback_link.help:
Share hit and Stagger Trap knockback with other enabled players.

Incoming impacts use their direction at normal Stagger Trap strength.

early_sprint.label: Early Sprint
early_sprint.help:
Place sprint early when Skills are randomized.
With Split Dash And Sprint enabled, only the first Progressive Swift Step is placed early.
Otherwise, the early Swift Step also grants dash.

vog_area_hints.label: Vog Area Hints
vog_area_hints.help:
Number of area reports Vog can sell. Reports count remaining progression
items for any player without revealing their names and update as you complete checks.

enemy_rosary_multiplier.label: Enemy Rosary Multiplier
enemy_rosary_multiplier.help: Multiply Rosaries dropped by defeated enemies only.

enemy_shard_multiplier.label: Enemy Shell Shard Multiplier
enemy_shard_multiplier.help: Multiply Shell Shards dropped by defeated enemies only.

faster_dialogue.label: Faster Dialogue
faster_dialogue.help: Speed up ordinary NPC dialogue without skipping conversations.

faster_silkheart_animation.label: Faster Silkheart Animation
faster_silkheart_animation.help:
Collect boss Silkhearts on contact. 

False keeps the vanilla pickup animation but skips the dream sequence.

trap_disguises.label: Trap Disguises
trap_disguises.help:
Disguise traps as major items in shops, wishes and crest slots.

Shop and wish icons are mirrored. Shop and crest-slot names contain small typos.

trap_percentage.label: Trap Percentage
trap_percentage.help:
Percent of eligible filler items in the random pool replaced by traps.

If every trap weight is zero, no traps are added.

stagger_trap_weight.label: Stagger Trap Weight
stagger_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Stagger Traps, zero disables them.

When staggered, Hornet receives knockback but takes no damage.

rosary_spill_trap_weight.label: Rosary Spill Trap Weight
rosary_spill_trap_weight.help: Relative frequency of Rosary Spill Traps, zero disables them.

darkness_trap_weight.label: Darkness Trap Weight
darkness_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Darkness Traps, zero disables them.

The screen is darkened to a small area of light around Hornet for 20 seconds.

cursed_crest_trap_weight.label: Cursed Crest Trap Weight
cursed_crest_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Cursed Crest Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is inflicted with the Cursed Crest for 90 seconds, as if she had done
the Rite of Rebirth quest with Greyroot.

muckmaggot_status_trap_weight.label: Muckmaggot Status Trap Weight
muckmaggot_status_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Muckmaggot Status Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is afflicted with Muckmaggots as if she fell into Bilewater. Binding
or using a bench removes them.

naked_trap_weight.label: Naked Trap Weight
naked_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of 90-second Naked Traps, zero disables them.

Hornet is left naked as if she were in the Slab escape sequence for 90 seconds.

literacy_trap_weight.label: Literacy Trap Weight
literacy_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Literacy Traps, zero disables them.

Interrupts with a randomly selected passage of pre-written text.
Advance each dialogue box to regain control while the action continues around you.

shader_trap_weight.label: Shader Trap Weight
shader_trap_weight.help:
Relative frequency of Shader Traps, zero disables them.

Applies a shader to the game camera with the potential shaders:
Oil Painting, Grayscale

local_items.label: Local Items
local_items.help: Forces these items to be in their native world.

non_local_items.label: Non-local Items
non_local_items.help: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

start_inventory.label: Start Inventory
start_inventory.help: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

start_inventory_from_pool.label: Start Inventory from Pool
start_inventory_from_pool.help:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.

start_hints.label: Start Hints
start_hints.help: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

start_location_hints.label: Start Location Hints
start_location_hints.help: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.

exclude_locations.label: Excluded Locations
exclude_locations.help: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

priority_locations.label: Priority Locations
priority_locations.help: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

item_links.label: Item Links
item_links.help: Share part of your item pool with other players.
